decision.evidence_summary: Preserve baseline tested: nominal weighted tardiness 919, on-time 1/8, makespan 292, 0 reroutes, 0 start shift. Repair-sensitivity forecasts: 919 at 95/115, 1199 at 135. Bounded stress +30min (repair 145) forecast: 1339 (+420 vs nominal), on-time 1/8, makespan 322, 0 reroutes/shifts. Late-repair risk increases tardiness/makespan but adds no churn cost. No reschedule/reroute forecasts tested; reroute would add 12min overhead +30 per op penalty. Forecasts only, not outcomes. Select preserve to protect commitments while avoiding unnecessary changes.

decision.evidence_summary: Tested preserve (baseline WT 989, on-time 1/8, makespan 297, worst 1129), reschedule (WT 731, on-time 4/8, makespan 300, shift 626, worst 831), reroute (WT 409, on-time 2/8, makespan 256, 3 reroutes, shift 943, worst 463). Objective: reroute ~42189 < reschedule ~74026 < preserve ~99197. Reroute +30min stress (CNC-A 150): WT 643, still below reschedule worst. Trade-off: reroute has lower on-time count than reschedule (2 vs 4) and higher shift/reroute cost, but best protects priority-weighted tardiness and makespan under uncertainty.
